title: 第9章 分别第10章 略微出手已是你的极限
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
翌日，天刚蒙蒙亮，沈云正在准备早餐。
沈卿若幽幽醒来，洗漱后坐到餐桌前，“今天怎么这么早，有什么事吗？”
沈云点了点头道：“等会要去一趟藏经阁。”
沈卿若当即道：“我陪你一起去。”
沈云看了她一眼，心中暗道：‘炼气三层的修为，卿若不该在这浪费时间了，回来就和她说这件事吧。
沈卿若被他的眼神看的有些奇怪，忍不住拿出水镜照了照，白皙的脸庞和平时没什么区别。
早饭过后，两人旋即动身，半小时后来到了藏经阁前。
天色尚早，宽阔的平台尽显空旷，明老正在广场上晨练。
掌心向下，身正腰松…
一套太极拳打的尽显仙意，动作格外舒展，仿佛迎风展翅的白色仙鹤。
见到来者，明老缓缓收功，自然道：“方先生去散步了，等会就会回来。”
沈云点头，找了个位置坐下等待。
片刻后，白衣身影飘然而至，步履轻健，犹如踏着晨曦而来。
见到沈云，他的双眸中讶色一闪而过，提问道：“你看懂它用了多长时间？”
沈云迟疑了片刻，缓声道：“一天。”
听到这个答案，白衣青年闭眸不语，沈卿若和明老都是一头雾水，不明白他们在打什么哑迷。
一炷香的时间过去，白衣青年再次睁眼，慎重的说道：“记住生灭本是一体，等你踏出第一步再来找我。”
旋即他丢给沈云一块玉牌，素面浅雕，刻有两条翱翔九天的飞龙，仔细一看竟是一个方字。
明老面色巨震，目光死死地盯着玉牌，心中掀起了惊涛骇浪。
沈云接过了玉牌，抱拳道：“无功不受禄，方先生可有其他吩咐，还请言明。”

对于眼前神秘莫测的方先生，沈云始终保持了几分警惕，一个外姓人镇守藏经阁，本身就透露着诡异，他可不想卷入什么漩涡中。
方先生挥了挥手，随口道：“你这点能耐能帮我什么，小小年纪这么老成，可是会失去不少乐趣的，这个小姑娘比你可爱多了。”
听闻此言，沈卿若磨了磨银牙，总感觉自己被小看了。
沈云松了一口气，“既然如此，小子就不打扰方先生了。”
说完他就带着沈卿若离去，走在路上小妮子还在嘀咕，“那家伙看着就不像好人，沈云哥哥可不要被骗了。”
等他俩走后，明老刚准备开口询问，有一仙风道骨的老者飘然而至。
见到来者，明老当即行礼道：“大长老。”
来者白发飘飘，眸光深邃，气势威严如海，正是沈家如今的掌舵者，大长老沈临风。
当年沈云得到大长老的一句夸奖，立刻就名声远扬，被誉为绝顶天才，这就是他的权威，早已深入人心。
不过今天大长老却一扫往日的威严，执礼道：“方先生近来可好。”
方先生打了个哈欠，懒洋洋的道：“有事直说，我最烦的就是这些无用的客套。”
如此轻慢的态度，大长老却不以为意，陈恳的说道：“不瞒方先生，沈家出了个水木双灵根的好苗子，更是身具乙木灵体，恳求先生能收她为徒。”
“乙木灵体，还是水木双生的天赋，这可不比天灵根差了啊。”
明老发出了感叹，怪不得能让大长老亲自出山，这种天才确实值得如此。
除灵根资质外，有极少数幸运儿得到上头宠爱，觉醒出特殊灵体，拥有种种不可思议的神效，比起天灵根也不遑多让，是真正的天之骄子。
如今沈家太上已有七百余岁，金丹上人的寿元极限也就八百载，若失去了这根擎天白玉柱，沈家立刻就会分崩离析。
这些年沈家一直在为后继无人发愁，没想到竟冒出了这样的天才，当真是天无绝人之路。
听到大长老的话，方先生却根本不为所动，平静道：“你说的那个小丫头，她刚刚才来过。”
content_en:
The next day, it was just dawn, and Shen Yun was preparing breakfast.
Shen Qingruo woke up faintly, washed up and sat at the dining table, "Why are you so early today? What can I do?"
Chen Yun nodded and said, "I'm going to visit the Scripture Collection Pavilion later."
Shen Qingruo immediately said: "I will go with you."
Chen Yun glanced at her and thought to himself: 'With the cultivation of the third level of Qi Refining, if you shouldn't waste your time here, you should talk to her about this when you come back.
Shen Qingruo looked a little strange from his eyes and couldn't help but take out a water mirror to take a look. Her fair face was no different from usual.
After breakfast, the two set off immediately and arrived in front of the Sutra Pavilion half an hour later.
It was still early in the morning, and the wide platform was completely empty. Ming Lao was doing his morning exercises on the square.
Palms down, body upright and waist relaxed...
A set of Tai Chi shows the spirit of immortality, and the movements are particularly stretched, like a white crane spreading its wings in the wind.
Seeing the person coming, Ming Lao slowly finished his work and said naturally: "Mr. Fang went for a walk and will be back later."
Shen Yun nodded, found a seat and sat down to wait.
After a while, a figure in white floated over, walking lightly and vigorously, as if walking in the morning light.
Seeing Shen Yun, surprise flashed across his eyes and he asked, "How long did it take you to understand it?"
Chen Yun hesitated for a moment and said slowly: "One day."
After hearing this answer, the young man in white closed his eyes and said nothing. Shen Qingruo and Ming Lao were both confused and didn't understand what they were talking about.
After a stick of incense passed, the young man in white opened his eyes again and said cautiously: "Remember that birth and death are one. Come to me after you take the first step."
Immediately, he threw a jade plaque to Shen Yun. It was plain and lightly carved, and was engraved with two flying dragons flying in the sky. Upon closer inspection, it turned out to be a square character.
Ming Lao's face was shocked, his eyes were fixed on the jade plaque, and there was a turmoil in his heart.
Chen Yun took the jade token, clasped his fists and said, "No reward for no merit. If Mr. Fang has any other instructions, please let me know."
Chen Yun had always been somewhat wary of the mysterious Mr. Fang in front of him. A man with a foreign surname guarding the Sutra Pavilion was inherently strange, and he did not want to get involved in any whirlpool.
Mr. Fang waved his hand and said casually: "How can your ability help me? Being so mature at such a young age will make you lose a lot of fun. This little girl is much cuter than you."
After hearing this, Shen Qingruo gritted her teeth, feeling that she had been underestimated.
Shen Yun breathed a sigh of relief, "In that case, I won't disturb Mr. Fang."
After saying that, he took Shen Qingruo away. While walking on the road, Xiao Nizi was still muttering, "That guy doesn't look like a good person. Brother Shen Yun, don't be deceived."
After they left, Ming Lao was just about to ask, when an old man with an immortal spirit floated over.
Upon seeing the visitor, Mr. Ming immediately saluted and said, "Great Elder."
The person who came had flowing white hair, deep eyes, and an aura as majestic as the sea. He was none other than the current helmsman of the Shen family, the eldest elder Shen Linfeng.
When Shen Yun received a compliment from the great elder, he immediately became famous and was hailed as a genius. This was his authority, which had already been deeply rooted in the hearts of the people.
But today, the great elder lost all his previous majesty and said with a salute: "Mr. Fang is doing well these days."
Mr. Fang yawned and said lazily: "Just tell me what you have to say. What annoys me the most are these useless politenesses."
The First Elder didn't take such a dismissive attitude seriously, and said earnestly: "To be honest with Mr. Fang, the Shen family has a good seedling with both water and wood spiritual roots. She also has a Yimu spirit body. I beg you, sir, to accept her as your disciple."
"The Yimu spirit body is the talent of the twins of water and wood. It is no worse than the Tianling root."
Ming Lao sighed, no wonder the Great Elder could come out in person, such a genius is indeed worthy of this.
In addition to spiritual root qualifications, there are a very small number of lucky people who are favored by their superiors and awaken special spiritual bodies with all kinds of incredible magical effects, which are no less impressive than those with heavenly spiritual roots.The true pride of heaven.
Now the Shen family's grand master is more than 700 years old, and the golden elixir master's life span is only 800 years. If this white jade pillar holding the sky is lost, the Shen family will immediately fall apart.
Over the years, the Shen family has been worrying about having no successors, but they never expected that such a genius would emerge.
After hearing what the great elder said, Mr. Fang was not moved at all and said calmly: "The little girl you mentioned was here just now."
